job_location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh / Gurgaon, Haryana, India

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: The role focuses on designing robust analytics datasets, mentoring junior engineers, and driving BI solutions with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and governance
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize governance, data quality, consistency, and standardization of KPIs with no velocity/speed language anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: Alight empowers clients to build a healthier and more financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, navigation, and absence management.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Benefits/HR/wealth administration touches financial and health data but the responsibilities themselves are framed generically (BI, dashboards, semantic layer) without explicit compliance or regulatory language, so moderate per the tie-breaker.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Engineers; BI teams; Product stakeholders
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: References to enterprise-grade data models, existing BI teams, distributed onshore/offshore teams, and an established analytics platform indicate a mature, specialized data organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and optimize datasets for BI tools (AWS QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific named tools (Redshift, DynamoDB, QuickSight, RLS/CLS models) and precise technical tasks make clear what this person does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: The ideal candidate will work closely with Data Engineers, BI teams, and Product stakeholders to build robust semantic models, and support enterprise analytics platforms.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is the internal data/BI ecosystem (Data Engineers, BI teams, semantic layer, enterprise analytics platform) rather than a specific commercial, finance, or product-metrics function.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mix of strategic ownership (own semantic layer architecture, define data model strategies, mentor junior engineers) and execution tasks (build dashboards, tune SQL, support ad-hoc analytics).
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools, AI-assisted coding, or AI-consuming data infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality/governance items (RLS/CLS, best practices) are listed as tasks under a named section but without a clear ownership/testing-framework verb, closer to tool/practice listing than an explicit testing responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure consistency, reusability, and scalability of data models
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: concern is centered on model consistency, governance, and performance rather than explicit compliance, audit, or regulatory risk language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities mix new semantic layer design and standardization with supporting existing enterprise analytics platforms and ETL/ELT pipelines, with no dominant signal either way.
evidence.work_arrangement: Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.
